_universe: The S&P 500, MidCap 400 and SmallCap 600 are scanned each morning, then filtered to liquid, volatile shares a $10k account can trade.
_setup: Opening range breakout on 'stocks in play' (Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz 2024; Toby Crabel).
_risk: Defence first (Paul Tudor Jones): small fixed risk, hard stops, daily loss limit.
_timing: New York time. Morning momentum only; flat before the close.
_learning: Rules added from losses, plus an end-of-day review that adapts slowly and only on evidence.
_news: No news feed for US shares yet.
_costs: Commission-free US broker; slippage for crossing the bid-ask spread.
